disclaimer: All sources are open or student-accessible data used to TRAIN and demonstrate the forecasting method. They are proxies and do not reflect the true state of the Malaysian labour market; that would need far higher-quality (licensed) data. Model quality is judged by how accurately it forecasts from the data it is given, not by how trustworthy the data is.

tiers.2: Curated listings or policy coverage. Leading but noisy.

time_grid.model_periods: weekly, Monday start (config.PERIOD_FREQ = 'W'); horizon, windows and gate are counted in these periods

keys.granularity: native granularity of the source's periods; the period is identified by its start date
keys.release_lag_days: a figure for period P is only known release_lag_days after the period ends (default 0)
keys.ffill_limit_days: how long a published figure is carried forward on the weekly grid (default: the granularity span, 7 / 31 / 92 / 366 days)
keys.max_staleness_days: older than this (measured from the period end plus release lag) the agent loop drops the source until it refreshes
keys.min_period_postings: adapters drop periods with fewer total postings than this
keys.min_entity_total: adapters keep an entity only if it has at least this many matches over the kept periods
keys.dense: true: every period between first and last kept period must exist and is zero-filled; false: gaps stay gaps
